review_name: SHS Private Beta Go/No-Go Review V1
private_beta_scope: Supervised, operator-managed private beta only for internal/demo/private beta clients under documented constraints.

evidence_reviewed.summary: 30 routes checked; 25 PASS, 5 WARNING, 0 FAIL; readiness score 92/100; private_beta_ready true.
Private beta allowed only as supervised operator-managed workflow; paid launch, public launch, self-service onboarding, public reporting, and unsupervised operation prohibited.
No critical leakage found; leakage risk score 18/100; private_beta_safe true; paid_launch_safe false.
Build packet readiness score 76/100; development handoff NEAR_READY; client review PARTIAL; delivery PARTIAL; paid delivery NO-GO.
Launch readiness score 64/100; ClientOps activation readiness 78/100; supervised launch rehearsal GO; paid launch NO-GO.
Hardening plan estimates 72 best-case, 120 likely, 176 conservative hours; paid launch requires all launch gate hardening items plus auth/session and durable persistence.

remaining_critical_blockers: No hard SHRV1 Launch Gate route/model.
Operator, QA, delivery, final, and client signoff are not all hard-enforced.
No formal rollback requirement is enforced before launch.
ClientOps activation is still local/internal rather than durable SHRV1 launch evidence.
Support owner or ClientOps owner is not hard-required.
Production auth/session gating is not complete for paid launch.
Durable production persistence is not complete for paid launch.
Build packet approval/export evidence is not signed, immutable, or client-safe.
Report/public claim readiness remains partly manual unless tied to Truth Spine/public approval at runtime.

next_5_fixes.why: Creates the evidence container needed for all later Launch Gate hardening.
Gives operators one admin surface to see launch readiness, blockers, and required approvals.

next_5_fixes.fix: Add required launch version record plus operator and QA signoff.
next_5_fixes.why: Hardens the minimum evidence needed before unsupervised private beta.

next_5_fixes.fix: Add rollback requirement and paid-launch blocker computation.
next_5_fixes.why: Prevents launch states from being marked ready without recovery planning and explicit blocker status.

next_5_fixes.fix: Harden ClientOps activation gate with support owner and durable activation evidence.
next_5_fixes.why: Closes the gap between Delivery Ready and ClientOps Active for paid launch.

estimated_time_to_private_beta.condition: Use only supervised operator-managed beta with internal/demo/private beta clients and the current constraints.

estimated_time_to_unsupervised_private_b.condition: Complete ledger, Launch Gate route/model, operator signoff, QA signoff, rollback requirement, and launch version record.

estimated_time_to_paid_launch.condition: Complete all Launch Gate hardening items, signed build packet/export evidence, production auth/session, durable persistence, report delivery policy, and public/private leakage automation.

required_private_beta_constraints: Named operator owns every beta workflow.
Every beta client is labeled internal, demo, or private beta.
Manual approval occurs before handoff, build packet approval, QA signoff, launch signoff, ClientOps activation, and reporting.
Local/demo persistence is disclosed and not treated as production durability.
No private SHS data is published to SHF public surfaces.
No private beta claims are marked public-approved.
Reports remain supervised and private unless separately approved through governance.
Governance checks pass before release checkpoints.
final_recommendation: SHS can enter supervised private beta now under the documented constraints. SHS cannot enter paid launch or public launch until launch gates, durable evidence, production auth/session, persistence, public/private leakage automation, and report/public-approval controls are hardened.
